g.text: Original optimizer grid: learning rate, dropout and weight decay
Validation only: 12-epoch, seed-0 screens. Each point averages the other optimizer settings within each split, then equally weights five splits.
Levels are equally spaced categories (including learning rate); curves are descriptive marginal means, not held-out scores or causal estimates.
The shared dropout setting in this original grid differs from the independent attention dropout in Figure 4.
